headline: DaVita (DVA) Stock Still Looks Undervalued Despite A Q2 Earnings Beat
summary: DaVita stock has climbed 69.6% over the past three years. After a recent pullback and a strong value score, the current price still raises questions about how much upside investors are actually paying for. Over the past 3 years, DaVita has returned 69.6%, which puts recent share price weakness in the context of a longer period of strong gains. Support for the valuation can come from expectations that DaVita benefits from growing demand for integrated kidney and metabolic care. Execution...
